android.desc:
Your brain is for having ideas — not holding them. Resyl is the AI memory app for the people in your life: a frictionless brain dump that catches the thought before it's gone. 
Speak it, type it, or snap a photo in under 10 seconds. Resyl reads it, structures it automatically, ties it to the right person, and gives it back the instant you ask. 
No folders. No tags. No decisions. The system remembers for you.
  
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  SOUND FAMILIAR?
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  • The thought is crystal clear — and then it's just... gone.
  • You forget a conversation the moment after you've had it.
  • You blank on the name of someone you already know well.
  • Every to-do app dies because keeping it organized is the hard part.

  Resyl is built for exactly this — gentle, judgment-free, effortless.

  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  HOW IT WORKS
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  CAPTURE — Speak, type, or photograph anything. "Met Priya at the conference — wants a follow-up by Thursday, interested in our Series A." Snap a whiteboard or card and Resyl reads the text too. Word vomit welcome — dump the chaos, Resyl sorts it.
ORGANIZE — AI extracts the person, the deal, the deadline, the location automatically. Nothing to file. Clear your mental RAM and close the open loops.
RECALL — Just ask. "What happened with Priya?" Resyl surfaces every memory tied to her as one clear answer — not a list of search results.
SHARE — Send a memory to a friend, or to a private Community. Your team, study group, or family — on the same page.

  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  WHAT YOU GET
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  ✦ AI Memory Feed — everything you've captured, organized by day
  ✦ People View — full conversation history per person
  ✦ Brain Map — a live constellation of how people, memories and topics connect
  ✦ Photo & OCR — snap a whiteboard, card, or document; Resyl pulls the text
  ✦ AI Search — ask in plain language, get a real answer
  ✦ Communities — share with groups; members see only what's relevant
  ✦ Reminders — natural language ("call him Friday 5pm") auto-detected

  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  WHO IT'S FOR
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
→ ADHD minds — catch the thought before working memory drops it; no system to maintain, no shame spiral
→ Founders tracking investor conversations and deal flow
→ Sales pros who need full client context before every call 
→ Students juggling professors, classmates, and deadlines
→ Networkers who want to be the one who always remembers
→ Anyone dro
